name: Taiga Wisemane
summary: Along Desolace's western coast, Taiga Wisemane keeps watch. From Shadowprey Village, he looks for dark sorceries stirring across the wastes.

sections.title: A Watchful Eye in Shadowprey
sections.body: Shadowprey Village is a Darkspear troll fishing settlement by the ocean. Taiga Wisemane has taken up station there to watch the dark sorceries stirring across Desolace. He knows spiritual corruption is seeping into the soil, and keeps his attention eastward. Shadow cults and demonic remnants fester among the ancient ruins.

sections.title: Stemming the Demonic Tide
sections.body:
The Burning Blade works from Thunder Axe Fortress, where its cult experiments with dark artifacts to widen its influence. Taiga sees the danger to Desolace's inhabitants and sends capable adventurers into the fortress to claim the Demon Box, which holds the Hand of Iruxos.

Taiga hopes this blow will deprive the cult of the focus it uses to tear the veil between worlds.

sections.title: Sealing the Coven's Portals
sections.body:
Securing the Hand of Iruxos is only the first step in Taiga's plan. At Mannoroc Coven in southern Desolace, the Burning Blade has already opened demonic rifts.

Taiga directs trusted champions to turn the dark focus against its makers. They channel its energy into the gateways, closing them before the Burning Legion can send reinforcements into Kalimdor's heart.

faq.answer: Taiga Wisemane is a tauren elder in Shadowprey Village on Desolace's western coast. He advises travelers and offers them work tracking and countering the Burning Blade's demonic rites.

faq.q: Why is a tauren living in Shadowprey Village?
faq.answer: Shadowprey Village is primarily a troll settlement and the Horde's main outpost along Desolace's coast. Taiga stays there to watch the wastes and enlist passing Horde travelers against nearby demonic threats.

faq.q: What is the Burning Blade doing in Desolace?
faq.answer: The Burning Blade is a cult whose shadow sorceries and demonic remnants trouble Desolace. Taiga watches for their spread from Shadowprey Village.

faq.q: What is the Hand of Iruxos?
faq.answer: The Hand of Iruxos is a demonic artifact held inside a Demon Box at Thunder Axe Fortress. The Burning Blade means to use its foul power to open portals to the Nether.
Mannoroc Coven lies in southern Desolace, where demonic corruption has taken hold. Taiga watches for the threats spreading through the region.

faq.q: Does Taiga belong to a specific tauren tribe?
faq.answer: Taiga carries the Wisemane surname and is an elder concerned with spiritual balance and demonic corruption. He serves the wider Horde under the banner of the united tribes.

angles.text: Taiga guides Horde champions traveling through Desolace. His counsel helps guard the Horde outpost at Shadowprey Village from demonic encroachment.
For tauren travelers, Taiga represents the duty to heal and protect Kalimdor from unnatural demonic blight. He stands against the dark legacy that has scarred Desolace.
Warlocks may note Taiga's understanding of the Hand of Iruxos. He uses the relic's resonance to collapse demonic portals instead of banishing them through holy rites.
